backward_compat_traps.rule: All ONFI devices power-up into SDR data interface, timing mode 0.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host assuming NV-DDR3 from boot will fail to read Parameter Page.

backward_compat_traps.rule: FFh returns to SDR; FCh preserves NV-DDR family + timing mode.
backward_compat_traps.trap: FFh on parity-error recovery loses NV-DDR3 setup and forces re-training.
Host with 1 ms timeout hangs on power-up.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Parameter Page CRC (8005h init 4F4Eh) at bytes 254-255 covers bytes 0-253.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host trusting first copy unconditionally may use corrupted geometry.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Wait ≥ tCCS after second address byte of Change Read/Write Column before data.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Omitting tCCS reads/writes at OLD column.

backward_compat_traps.rule: WP_n shall not transition during active Program/Erase or with Write Enable active.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mid-program WP_n glitch can corrupt the page.

backward_compat_traps.rule: 78h shall not be used during/after Target-level commands.
backward_compat_traps.trap: 78h during Read Parameter Page poll returns undefined data.
Hosts must use higher-layer policy for read protection.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Factory-marked bad blocks have non-FFh first byte in spare area; erase fails.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Drivers trying to 'recover' a factory-bad block may retire a good block.

fields.spec_version: Open NAND Flash Interface Specification Revision 4.1 (December 12, 2017)

spec_lineage_onfi.summary: Initial ONFI release; asynchronous SDR only; basic command set + 256-byte Parameter Page.
Multi-plane; Read Cache; Read Status Enhanced (78h).
NV-DDR2 + ZQ Calibration + CE_n pin reduction (Volume Select E1h).
NV-DDR2 to 800 MT/s; Extended Parameter Page 'EPPS'.
NV-DDR3 + Independent Data Buses + ODT Configure (E2h).
NV-DDR3 to 1200 MT/s; DCC + DQ training (18h/62h/63h/64h/76h).

spec_lineage_legacy_nand.summary: Pre-ONFI vendor-defined CLE/ALE/WE_n/RE_n/CE_n bus with similar but incompatible command-set details.

fields.version_naming_history_note: ONFI is managed by the ONFI Workgroup (Intel, Micron, Phison, Western Digital, SK Hynix, Sony). The competing standard is the Samsung-led Toggle Mode DDR NAND. At ONFI 4.x and Toggle DDR4 the industry has converged on near-identical electrical signaling but different command sequencing; many modern NAND devices implement both for multi-vendor sourcing.

key_changes.summary: Source-synchronous NV-DDR — first DDR NAND interface.
Multi-plane + Read Cache — first major throughput boost.
Extended Parameter Page (EPPS) + Extended ECC Information.
NV-DDR3 + Independent Data Buses + matrix termination.
NV-DDR3 1.2 GT/s + DCC + DQ training commands.
